text: Over the last 30 days, several visitors expressed frustration with the heavy use of AI in the exhibits, describing it as distracting and not educational. Some found the interactive kiosks difficult to use, especially for taller guests. Lighting and signage issues were also mentioned, making navigation and viewing exhibits challenging. A few reviews noted dissatisfaction with the food service, citing poor quality and long wait times. While the building’s architecture received positive comments, concerns about the overall visitor experience and interpretation remain.

A few noted that certain interactive elements, such as photo kiosks, were not accessible for taller guests. While many reviews mentioned positive aspects like the interactive exhibits, architecture, and conservation message, concerns about the educational value and historical balance were also raised. Overall, the average rating remained high, but attention to the AI features and accessibility could improve the visitor experience.
